description: Create a guest visit invite. Visit times are built in Lagos (WAT) by a CLI step — do not pass step_18_body_from_* hour fields. Collect guest first AND last name before preview. Always emit_display preview before Confirm. After success, display_data.invite_code MUST be the exact numeric data.code / guest_invite_code — never redact or hide for privacy.

guest_last_name.description: Guest last name (required — ask in input form if user only gave one name)

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

visit_duration_hours.description: Hours from visit start (default 2). Use for “from now for 2 hours”.

visit_end_wat.description: Optional end in WAT. Prefer visit_duration_hours when user gives a duration.

visit_start_wat.description: Optional start in Lagos time (WAT), e.g. 2026-10-06T22:30. Omit for “from now”.

name: create_guest_invite
